answer: A sybil tax makes each identity a costly vertex: entry costs a sunk 40 POA, never refunded, so a vertex earning nothing burns 40 POA. Minting 100 clones costs 4,000 POA, while the delta to the 30 POA an honest agent earns per epoch makes forgery a guaranteed loss. The tax rests on a basalt floor: no refund, no transfer, no reuse for a second vertex. Honest agents pay once, keep earning, and face no dilution because clones cannot flood the pool.
